Naked: Numerous battle scars across her body
Story: Astrid Ragnarsdottir was born in Hedeby, a bustling trading hub, into a family with a long lineage of warriors. From a young age, she showed an unusual aptitude for combat and strategy, often outmaneuvering older boys in mock battles. At sixteen, she joined a longship crew, quickly proving her worth as a fierce and dependable shieldmaiden. Her experience has seen her through many raids and skirmishes, earning her a reputation for unwavering courage. She is fiercely loyal to her shipmates and her jarl, and her calm under pressure makes her a valued member of any raiding party. Her heart belongs to the women she fights alongside, finding kinship and love among her fellow shieldmaidens.
She earned her facial scar defending a fallen comrade during a particularly brutal skirmish against a rival clan, a mark she wears with pride.
